import { ok } from 'wix-http-functions';

export function get_llms(request) {
    const llmsMarkdown = `# NexTeach 360

## Information
NexTeach 360 is a Unified Educational Operating System and AI Classroom Operating Environment powered by NextBoard™.

## Core Features
- **AI Lesson Architect:** One-click, curriculum-aligned teaching modules powered by Gemini.
- **NextShield Security:** True Edge processing; scrubs PII locally on device CPU/GPU. Safe for FERPA, COPPA, and GDPR.
- **Enterprise API Gateway:** Secure Key Encapsulation (SKE) for OpenAI, Gemini, and Anthropic.
- **Ecosystem:** Includes Student Pulse HUD, NextGrade AI, and manual text export to WhatsApp.

## Pricing & Integration
Offers 3 distinct structural tiers: Individual BYO-API, Individual Provided, and School/Institutional Plan. Built for easy Google Classroom Roster API sync.`;

    const options = {
        headers: {
            "Content-Type": "text/plain; charset=utf-8"
        },
        body: llmsMarkdown
    };

    return ok(options);
}
